Test whether PD-L1 or immunologic infiltrate in the tumor microenvironment are associated with objective tumor response

coder_notes: TMB >= 10 is an entry requirement for checkpoint blockade, so coded candidate_matched true (hypermutation rationale for ipilimumab + nivolumab stated in summary). Eligibility accepts both IDH-wildtype glioblastoma and IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma (CNS5 terminology), so IDH is an eligibility row. MSI is only an exploratory correlative alongside MGMT.
